title: Maximum power condition
description: Essential: Student must identify that R₂ = 0 Ω for maximum power in R₁.

title: Maximum power calculation
description: Essential: Student must compute P_max = 1.125 W using correct current and R₁.

title: Circuit current determination
description: Important: Student must apply Ohm's law for closed circuit to find current when R₂ = 0.

title: Charge from i-t graph
description: Essential: Student must calculate ΔQ = 7.5×10⁻³ C from area under current-time curve.

title: Capacitor voltage change
description: Important: Student must determine ΔU = 2.5 V by comparing open and closed switch voltages.

title: Capacitance calculation
description: Essential: Student must compute C₁ = 3×10⁻³ F using C = ΔQ/ΔU.

title: Voltage divider application
description: Important: Student must correctly apply voltage divider to find capacitor voltage when switch closed.

title: Sign error in ΔU
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly subtracts voltages (U₁' - U₁ instead of U₁ - U₁').

title: Ignoring internal resistance
description: Pitfall: Student omits internal resistance r in circuit calculations.
